name: Workday Financial Management
description_en:
Workday Financial Management is an enterprise cloud finance product covering accounting operations, reporting, controls, close/consolidation and related financial processes. Its current product page groups accounting, projects/grants and planning, but those navigation groups are not a contract-entitlement statement.

The documented operating model retains business context from transactions into accounting and reports, with workflows and controls around approvals and exceptions. This profile is a primary-source product review, not a tenant implementation or measured close-performance study.
description_zh:
Workday Financial Management 是企业云财务产品，覆盖会计运营、报表、控制、结账合并及相关财务流程。当前产品页将会计、项目资助和规划分组展示，但这些导航分组不是合同权限说明。

资料描述的运营模式，是将业务背景随交易保留到会计和报表，并通过流程控制审批和异常。本文属于官方资料研究，未实施租户，也未测量结账性能。

core_features.explanation_zh: 会计将交易业务维度保留到日记账及财务报表。

core_features.explanation_en: The close product describes currency translation/revaluation, intercompany elimination and a task workspace.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结账产品介绍币种折算重估、内部交易抵销及任务工作区。

core_features.explanation_en: The accounting material describes approvals, segregation of duties, audit trails and configurable workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 会计资料介绍审批、职责分离、审计轨迹和可配置流程。

sections.title_en: Define the finance scope within Workday
sections.title_zh: 在 Workday 内明确财务范围
sections.en:
The product overview places accounting, Accounting Center, reporting, controls, consolidation, revenue management, projects/grants and planning within a financial-management presentation. Workday’s navigation separately lists HCM, payroll, student and other products. A shared platform does not establish that buying Financial Management includes every product or agent.

This deserves evaluation when an organization needs finance processes and detailed business context across entities, teams and operational sources. An invoice-only buyer should first weigh implementation ownership against that scope. This is an editorial fit judgment from the product model, not a claim that enterprise scale or any specific industry’s requirements have been independently validated.
sections.zh:
产品概览在财务管理展示中列出会计、Accounting Center、报表、控制、合并、收入管理、项目资助和规划。Workday 导航另外列出 HCM、薪资、学生等产品。共用平台不能证明购买 Financial Management 就包含所有产品和 Agent。

若组织需要跨实体、团队和业务来源的财务流程及细粒度背景，可以进一步评估；只需开票的采购者应先比较实施责任与该范围是否相称。这是从产品模式推导的适用性判断，不能声称企业规模或特定行业要求已经独立验证。

sections.title_en: Keep dimensions and source lineage visible
sections.en:
The accounting page describes one data model for general ledger, payables, receivables, assets, cash and reports. Business dimensions remain available through financial statements, while Accounting Center is presented as the component for turning high-volume operational data into accounting with transaction lineage.

For a hypothetical supplier invoice assigned to a project and entity, ask a demonstration to follow approval, accounting and reporting while retaining those attributes. Then correct an attribute under the intended authorization and inspect the change evidence. These are proposed acceptance checks, not proof of an implemented rule. Import mappings, chart design, accounting policy and ownership of external data still need explicit decisions.
sections.zh:
会计页介绍总账、应付、应收、资产、现金和报表共用数据模型，业务维度随数据保留至财务报表。Accounting Center 则定位为将大量业务数据转为会计并保留交易来源链路的组件。

可假设一张归属指定项目和实体的供应商发票，在演示中跟踪审批、会计和报表，并确认属性一直保留；再按预期授权更正一个属性，检查变更证据。这是建议验收，不能证明规则已经实施。导入映射、科目设计、会计政策和外部数据责任仍需明确决定。

sections.title_en: Consolidation needs rules and unresolved work needs an owner
sections.title_zh: 合并依赖规则，未结事项需要负责人
sections.en:
The close/consolidation page describes intercompany eliminations, currency revaluation and translation, ownership rules, non-controlling interests and retained-earnings calculations. Its workspace brings tasks, deadlines, dependencies, ownership and readiness together. These capabilities address more than displaying a consolidated total.

Evaluate two entities with a reciprocal transaction and one currency difference: inspect the local figures, translation basis, elimination and consolidated outcome. Then leave a reconciliation item unresolved and inspect the close status and responsible user. This is an illustrative scenario; none of those calculations were run. Continuous accounting does not establish that every exception can be ignored or that results meet a particular statutory standard without configuration.
sections.zh:
结账合并页面介绍内部交易抵销、币种重估与折算、所有权规则、非控股权益及留存收益计算。工作区把任务、截止时间、依赖、责任人和准备状态集中起来，所解决的任务超出单纯显示一个合并总额。

可用两个实体的一笔对等交易及一项币种差异评估，查看本地金额、折算基础、抵销及合并结果，再保留一个未解决对账项目，检查结账状态和责任用户。这是说明性场景，均未运行；持续会计不能证明异常可以忽略，也不能证明未经配置就满足某项法定标准。

sections.title_en: An implementation starts before the first live posting
sections.title_zh: 实施工作始于第一笔正式过账之前
sections.en:
Prepare entity structures, currencies, books, charts/dimensions, approval responsibilities, roles and external-data mappings. The overview describes embedded approvals/security/audit trails, and the accounting page describes exception handling and automated work. Their effectiveness depends on the tenant’s configured processes and access, not just on a public feature description.

Use representative historical balances and transactions to compare migration output with the prior system. Include a failed import, unauthorized approval attempt and a corrected entry in acceptance. These are editorial test suggestions. Integration endpoints, regional tax filings, retention/export and restore behavior were not established by this research. The public login guidance also directs existing users to their own HR/IT team for their organization’s sign-in page.
sections.zh:
先准备实体结构、币种、账簿、科目维度、审批责任、角色和外部数据映射。概览介绍内嵌审批、安全和审计轨迹，会计页介绍异常处理及自动化；能否有效运行取决于租户的流程与权限配置，不是公开功能描述本身。

用代表性历史余额和交易将迁移结果与旧系统对照，并在验收中加入导入失败、未授权审批尝试和更正分录。这些属于编辑测试建议。本次未确立集成端点、地区税务申报、保留导出和恢复行为。公开登录指引还要求现用户向自身 HR 或 IT 团队取得组织登录地址。

sections.title_zh: 取得明确范围的商业方案
sections.en:
The official product pages lead to Contact Sales or Request a Demo, and the contact page offers a sales route. The pages read did not establish a public monthly amount, a billing denominator, a permanent free edition or a universal package of agents. Price and licensing remain a vendor-contract question.

Request the required finance products, entities, integrations, implementation/conversion work, environments, support and AI consumption terms in the proposal. These are buying questions, not confirmed separate charges. A product demo is not an unrestricted trial tenant. No form was submitted, no quote was received and this profile does not infer an open-source or self-hosting right.
sections.zh:
官方产品页引导至 Contact Sales 或 Request a Demo，联系页提供销售渠道；已读页面未确立公开月费、计费分母、永久免费版本或通用 Agent 套装，价格和许可仍需由厂商合同确认。

方案中应明确所需财务产品、实体、集成、实施转换、环境、支持及 AI 用量条款。这些是采购问题，不是已确认的独立收费。产品演示也不等于可无限使用的试用租户。本文未提交表单或取得报价，也不推定开源或自托管权利。

sections.title_en: Vendor automation claims are not an accuracy result
sections.title_zh: 厂商自动化主张不是准确率结果
sections.en:
The current pages emphasize finance agents, reconciliation and exception detection and display customer-result percentages. Those remain vendor-reported capabilities and selected results; this profile does not reproduce them as an expected outcome or quality rating.

Before relying on an automated action, inspect which data it reads, what it can change, who reviews exceptions and how the resulting evidence can be traced. The research did not test agent accuracy, service availability, a close deadline or regulatory compliance. English/Chinese editorial coverage of this profile also does not establish a specific tenant’s interface languages or contractual country availability.
sections.zh:
当前页面强调财务 Agent、对账和异常识别，并展示客户结果百分比。这些仍属于厂商报告的能力和选取结果，本文不把它们转写为预期收益或质量评分。

依赖自动操作前，应检查其读取哪些数据、能更改什么、谁复核异常，以及结果证据如何追溯。本文未测试 Agent 准确性、服务可用性、结账期限或监管合规。本档案提供英中编辑正文，也不证明某个租户的界面语言或合同国家可用性。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Contracted products/agents, billing basis, regional tax/statutory coverage and tenant UI languages remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 合同产品 Agent、计费基础、地区税务法定覆盖及租户界面语言未核实。

research_gaps.en: No tenant, migration, controls, consolidation calculations, AI accuracy, availability or recovery was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试租户、迁移、控制、合并计算、AI 准确性、可用性或恢复。
